description: Android MainActivity class for a TV-optimized app that hosts a WebView loading a local HTML page (home-page-1-2.html). It sets up WebView configuration, handles navigation events, and manages focus and remote control key events.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity hosts a WebView configured for TV navigation, loading a local HTML asset as the home screen, and handling remote control input.

methods.name: loadHome
methods.description: Loads the local home-page-1-2.html file into the WebView, acting as the app's home screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, configures WebView settings, sets up clients, and loads the home page.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote control key events; maps ENTER and DPAD_CENTER to WebView click actions, manages back navigation.
